# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church wasn't a suggestion—it was a battle cry. Every morning you wake up, you step onto a battlefield. The world, your flesh, and the enemy all want you passive, distracted, and soft. But God calls you to something different: to be watchful, to stand firm, to act like men, and to be strong.

Notice the order. Watchfulness comes first. You can't stand firm if you're spiritually asleep. Strength in Scripture isn't just physical—it's moral and spiritual resolve forged in prayer, Scripture, and discipline. A man who neglects his soul will eventually crumble under pressure, no matter how strong his body is.

Today, don't drift through your hours on autopilot. Guard your eyes, your words, and your time. Stand firm when temptation whispers. Act like men—take responsibility, lead where you can, and refuse to shrink back. Real strength is found in a man who fears God more than he fears anything else. Rise up. The day is yours to claim for the Kingdom.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, pausing between each set to thank God for the strength He gives. Then pray for one area where you need to "stand firm" today.
